tasks.short: Supervise security staff without scoring them

steps.what: Open the roster of security professionals
Supervise hiring, training, and assigning work
Decide hiring or disciplining without scoring performance

tasks.design: The roster of security professionals is opened from {HCM}. Hiring, training, assigning work, and disciplining stay in person. A performance note is the manager's decision and is not a score. Backgrounds are read by the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision notes and hiring decisions were informal and easy to dispute.
tasks.enabler_now: A roster can show who is employed, without ranking them.
tasks.still_hard: Hiring, discipline, and a judgement of performance stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees the work. A file does not.
tasks.altitude: The roster is available. Decisions about people are still made in person and are not scored.

reach.task: Carry out a hiring or discipline decision
reach.learn: What the manager decided and what was refused

evidence.claim: A roster is a list of people, not an appraisal. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the manager supervises the security professionals and ends when a hiring or discipline decision is recorded by the manager.
A roster row has a person id and a post, produced by employment records. The system stores no score. A background file is read by the manager and is not parsed into a hire recommendation.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether background files may be stored, and who may see them.
research_questions: Does a works council already cover appraisal and hiring tools?

already_counted.description: Supervision time is already in the supervision step.

incremental.description: Correct a decision note if the underlying fact changes.

approvals.approved_version: hiring or discipline decision the manager made

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the roster is paper. No score is produced. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Decide policies that protect people from threats

steps.what: Collect stored harassment and threats records
Draft protection methods from those records

loop.purpose: Draft protection methods that cite only stored reports.
loop.output: Method clauses that each cite a report id.
loop.check: Every clause cites a stored report, and no incident is invented.
loop.stop: Stop when a report id is missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A standard policy text cannot show which report it answers.

tasks.design: Stored harassment and threat reports are listed from the {OPS_SYSTEM}. A draft method cites only those reports. The security manager decides the policy that protects personnel, and only that decision is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protection policies were rewritten without the report list.
tasks.enabler_now: A report can be stored with a type and a date.
tasks.still_hard: How to protect people, including from violence, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows a threat the report only hints at.
tasks.altitude: The policy starts from reports that exist. The protection decision stays with the manager.

evidence.claim: The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. A method draft cites report ids. It does not judge a person.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when harassment or threat reports exist and ends when the manager issues the protection policy.
A report has an id, a type, and a date, produced by the person who received it. A report about a named person is not turned into a finding by the draft.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Who may see harassment reports, and for how long.
research_questions: Which threat types must be escalated outside the security team?

already_counted.description: Deciding the policy is already in the decision step.

incremental.description: Retire a method when its report is withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: protection policy the manager decided from those reports

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when reports are not stored. The protection decision stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage procedures for access and call centers

steps.what: List procedures for security call centers
Recommend security procedure changes for operations
Manage access control and reporting tools

tasks.design: Procedures for security call centers are listed from {DOCS}. The security manager recommends changes and manages access control and reporting tools on the {OPS_SYSTEM}. A setting is filed only after that decision. Access is not changed by a draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Access settings and call-centre procedures lived in separate notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Current procedures can be listed, and access settings can be named.
tasks.still_hard: What to recommend, and who may pass a door, stays the manager's decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows an operation the written procedure misses.
tasks.altitude: The procedure list is current. Changing access still waits for the manager.

evidence.claim: Listing procedures is configuration. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Access changes are a decision, not a draft.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when operations procedures or access settings are reviewed and ends when the manager files the procedures.
A procedure has an id and a text. An access point has an id and a current rule, produced by the access record. A point with no id is not changed.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether call-centre procedures and door rules are in the same store.
research_questions: Who may approve a change to access?

already_counted.description: Recommending changes is already in the recommendation step.

incremental.description: Revert a setting if the filed procedure is withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: procedures and access settings the manager accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when procedures are not stored. Access is not changed by a list. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and walk security for special events

steps.what: Open the brief for the special event
Walk the posts before the event starts

tasks.design: The event brief is opened from {DOCS} and the date from {CALENDAR}. Planning security for special events, and walking the posts, stay with the security manager. A brief is not a plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event security was replanned from a mail thread each time.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief and the date can be opened together.
tasks.still_hard: A high-risk event is planned by walking it, not by a template.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees a crowd route the brief omits.
tasks.altitude: The brief is in one place. The plan and the walk stay with the manager.

reach.task: Run the event on the manager's plan

evidence.claim: The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. An event brief is not a security plan.

assumptions: The work starts when a special event is booked and ends when the manager has walked the posts.
A brief has an event id, a place, a date, and a headcount, produced by the event lead. A missing headcount is left blank.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether event briefs name the place and the expected headcount.
research_questions: Which events this firm treats as high-risk?

already_counted.description: The walk is already in the walk step.

incremental.description: Revise the plan if the headcount changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the brief is a mail thread. The walk stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Hiring, discipline, and performance notes stay with the manager, and nobody is scored. Protection policy and event security are decided in person. A procedure list does not change access by itself.
reach: People management sees the decision, not a score.
The event lead sees the plan after the walk.
skills_to_grow: Do not recommend a hire from a background file.
Do not change a door rule from a draft.
role.ambitious_version: Staff decisions stay in person. A report can refresh a protection draft, and the old wording is not issued.
